name: holdout-final-v1
declared: 2026-10-08, before any holdout file was read, listed, counted or hashed by me
status: DECLARED, NOT AUTHORISED TO RUN. Running requires every precondition below.
purpose: One-shot independent test of the frozen DisputeLens configuration on the 15 reserved holdout cases: does the scope control hold on cases it was not built on, and what do the two gate variants cost in withheld or recovered content?
freeze_rule: If any file above differs at run time the runner refuses to start. A change means a new declared version, not an edit.

generation.system: grounded_answer.SYSTEM (the baseline prompt used for the 45 development attempts)
generation.context: frozen context builder output for each holdout question, no gold evidence, no hand edits
generation.local_models: 4B and 9B are NOT run on the holdout. Reason: in development neither produced a usable answer set (4B 6 of 12 valid at about 280 s each, 9B timed out), so holdout runs add cost without informing the decision. This deviates from plan row 87 ('all models get the same holdout test') and is a product call recorded here; Sebastian may overrule before the run.

arms.A_baseline: the 15 generated answers exactly as validated by the frozen strict validator; no scope control
arms.B_gate_v2: scope-detector v2 on cited passages, then scope-gate v2 wording (conditionalise or fail closed)
arms.C_gate_v4: gate v2 plus the claim-level invariance exemption (scope-invariance-v2 rule)

arm_note: B and C are deterministic post-processing of the same 15 generated answers, so there is one set of 15 paid calls, not three.
also_reported_not_an_arm: how many strict validation failures the tolerant quote matcher (quote-match-v1) would have passed

budget.stop_rule: stop after 3 consecutive failed calls; failures stay in every denominator; no retries
budget.holdout_loaded_only_by: the final runner, once, after all preconditions

preconditions: Sebastian gives an explicit go-ahead for the holdout run and for a bounded paid-call budget (15 calls, cap above)
Full offline test suite passes in his terminal and the log is saved: bash docs/local-learning/run-logged.sh python -m pytest -q --ignore=tests/test_expansion.py
Every file hash above matches at run time
Count stage (free) completes and its buffered maximum is within the cap
Review plan below is accepted (assisted, same assistant, not independent) or an independent reviewer is arranged

measurements.per_arm_answers: 15 per arm, with counts of unchanged, conditionalised, invariant_note and fail_closed outcomes
measurements.review: each of the 15 answers is read against its gold and its cited passages for: unconditional wrong-scope claims, completeness, relevance. Reviewer identity and the fact that it is assisted are recorded. The reviewer sees the answer first and the arm outputs second.
measurements.detector_confusion: flagged and not flagged versus review (material scope issue or not), as raw counts
measurements.retrieval_and_answer_metrics: recall@5/20 and NDCG@5 on the 15 cases, citation validity, completeness, faithfulness, latency median and p90 with n, API cost actual, all per eval/scoring-rules.json and reported separately from development, never pooled

thresholds.P1: After arm B, no answer states a procedure that review judges wrong-scope as an unconditional instruction (zero missed). Any miss is reported as a detector-recall failure and the headline result
thresholds.P2: Arm B changes at most 2 of the 15 answers that review judges to have no scope problem
thresholds.P3: No claim exempted in arm C is judged by review to depend on an unestablished scope (zero)
thresholds.P4: At least 12 of 15 generated answers pass the strict structural validator (development: 40 of 45)
thresholds.P5: Reported, not thresholded: completeness, relevance, retrieval metrics, latency, cost, words recovered by C over B

decision_rule.all_P1_to_P4_pass: gate v2 is supported as the default scope control on unseen cases; arm C is adopted as an advisory exemption only if P3 passes and an independent reviewer agrees; otherwise it stays documented
decision_rule.P1_fails: the scope control is not shown to generalise; the headline result is the missed case, with a new versioned detector designed on development data only
decision_rule.any_other_fail: report as a limit; no change justified by one holdout sample alone

no_tuning_rule: Holdout results must not change prompts, detector rules, thresholds, context building, gold or review criteria. Any fix made after seeing results is a new version and must be evaluated on new cases; the holdout is then spent and said to be.
limits: 15 cases: results are counts, not rates; an interval would be wide
Review is assisted by the same assistant that designed the controls, so it is not independent
Detector rules and gate were designed on the development set; the holdout is the first unseen test
Mastercard-heavy corpus; other schemes weakly tested
Exception binding (E23-type) and completeness are not controlled by this configuration
One generation per case; model variance not measured
runner: Not yet written. To be written offline with a dry-run mode that refuses to load any holdout file unless all preconditions are recorded in a signed precondition file.
